summary: Installable Codex plugin package for the standalone Clash Timeline MCP tools and MCP App GUI.
context_hints: Keep plugin-specific contracts, Host adapter, MCP server, and GUI inside this package
Use the neutral Project Host client directly; CLI and MCP are peer interfaces and must not invoke one another
All GUI writes must use real Timeline read-proof and apply behavior
Entity mutations expose the persisted Timeline entity declared by the shared operation schema; Host receipt envelopes and read proofs stay in the adapter

subdirectories.src: Typed Timeline plugin contract, Project Host adapter, MCP server, and embedded GUI client.
subdirectories.skills: Codex workflow guidance bundled with the plugin.
subdirectories.runtime: Bundled install-time Node runtime generated by pnpm build.

key_files..mcp.json: Bundled stdio MCP server launch configuration.
key_files.src/adapter.ts: Only Host adapter; calls the neutral Project Host client and projects public results while retaining observations internally.
key_files.src/server.ts: Typed MCP tools and MCP App resource registration.

architecture_notes: The plugin is independently installable and cohesive. Timeline domain code may remain elsewhere in Clash; this package owns only the Codex plugin interface and its host adapter.
